# Alok Plastics

> Alok Plastics is a Chandigarh-based manufacturer, established in 1998, of moulded plastic and steel spare parts for water coolers, display counters and deep freezers.

## Facts
- Established: 1998
- Location: Chandigarh, India
- Owner: Gopal Kumar
- CEO: Aalok Kumar
- Tagline: Crafted in Bharat, made for the world.
- Delivery: Pan Bharat delivery network
- Company-reported: 20 Cr+ products successfully delivered
- Company-reported: 70%+ repeat customers

## Contact
- Address: Plot No-06, Industrial Area Phase II, Ram Darbar, Chandigarh 160003, India
- Enquiries and quotes: https://alokplastics.com/enquiry/ (prices are shared on request, per part and quantity)

# Full parts list

## Water Cooler spare parts
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/water-cooler-spare-parts/
Float valves, push cocks, waste pipes, couplings, ventilation jalli and adjustable leg inserts for water coolers and dispensers.

### Connecting Bush
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/water-cooler-spare-parts/connecting-bush/
A connecting bush available in brass and nylon, used to join pipes and fittings in water cooler and deep freezer systems.
- Material: Brass
- Sizes / variants: 2"; 2.5"; 3"; Nylon variant

### Float Valve
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/water-cooler-spare-parts/float-valve/
A nylon float valve that controls the water level inside water coolers and dispensers.
- Material: Nylon
- Used in: Water cooler

### Push Cock
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/water-cooler-spare-parts/push-cock/
A brass push-type tap for water dispensing on water coolers. Available in light and heavy duty.
- Material: Brass
- Used in: Water cooler
- Sizes / variants: Light; Heavy

### Waste Pipe
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/water-cooler-spare-parts/waste-pipe/
A PPCP waste pipe for draining overflow water from water coolers and display counters.
- Material: PPCP
- Used in: Water cooler, Display counter

### Waste Coupling
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/water-cooler-spare-parts/waste-coupling/
A coupling connector for waste pipe assemblies.

### Ventilation Jalli
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/water-cooler-spare-parts/ventilation-jalli/
A PPCP ventilation grille that fits water coolers, display counters and deep freezers to allow airflow while keeping out debris.
- Material: PPCP
- Used in: Water cooler, Display counter, Deep freezer
- Sizes / variants: RS 60; RS 75; RS 80; RS 130

### Adjustable Leg Insert
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/water-cooler-spare-parts/adjustable-leg-insert/
An HDPE adjustable insert for equipment legs, allowing fine height adjustment and protecting floors. Available in round and square tube sections, five sizes.
- Material: HDPE
- Used in: Water cooler, Display counter, Deep freezer
- Sizes / variants: 1" Round; 1" Square; 1.25" Round; 1.25" Square; 1.5" Round; 1.5" Square; 1.75" Round; 1.75" Square; 2" Round; 2" Square

## Deep freezer & Display counter Parts
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/
Sliding bushes, locks, hinges, springs and gaskets for the doors of display counters and deep freezers.

### F-Bush
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/f-bush/
A nylon sliding bush for display counter door channels, reducing friction and ensuring smooth door travel.
- Material: Nylon

### Door Lock
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/door-lock/
A locking mechanism for display counter and deep freezer doors.
- Used in: Display counter, Deep freezer

### Hinge
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/hinge/
Hinges for the doors of display counters and deep freezers.
- Used in: Display counter, Deep freezer

### Handle Lock
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/handle-lock/
A combined handle and lock component.

### Bracket Handle
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/bracket-handle/
A bracket-style handle for equipment doors and panels.

### SS Kabja
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/ss-kabja/
A stainless steel hinge (kabja) for equipment doors.
- Material: SS

### L-Type Hinge
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/l-type-hinge/
An L-type hinge for door and panel applications.

### U-Type Door Spring
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/u-type-door-spring/
A U-type spring for self-closing door mechanisms.

### L-Hinge Door Spring
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/l-hinge-door-spring/
A spring mechanism for L-type hinged doors.

### Gasket
URL: https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/gasket/
A door gasket that seals the frame of display counters and deep freezers, preventing heat exchange and moisture ingress.
- Used in: Display counter, Deep freezer
